rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing or expressing something in a rough, unrefined way.

example.english: They crudely drew a few strokes and said they were done.
example.traditional: 佢粗粗哋咁畫咗幾筆，就話自己完成喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 cou1 cou1 dei2 gam3 waak6 zo2 gei2 bat1 zau6 waa6 zi6 gei2 jyun4 sing4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when “crudely” means roughly or sketchily rather than carefully or in detail.

example.english: I crudely sketched out the plan once; ask me if you have any questions.
example.traditional: 我粗略咁講一次個計劃，你有問題再問。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cou1 loek6 gam3 gong2 jat1 ci3 go3 gai3 waak6 nei5 jau5 man6 tai4 zoi3 man6

rows.note: Use this only when the crude manner is specifically rude, uncivil, or lacking social refinement.

example.english: They crudely interrupted someone, leaving everyone at the table stunned.
example.traditional: 佢粗魯咁打斷人哋講嘢，搞到成枱人都呆咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 cou1 lou5 gam3 daa2 tyun5 jan4 dei6 gong2 je5 gaau2 dou3 sing4 ci4 jan4 dou1 ngoi4 zo2
